# Contributing

(First Draft | Written by dermi1002)

## A Quick Rundown:

- All contributions must start with an issue, next fork the repo and create a branch for it, then create a pull request.

- All contributions will be licensed under MIT. See the license for details.

## Code of Conduct:

- All discussions in this repo are to be focused on the project. Discussions of any other topic are to be brought outside of the repo.

- Everyone is to be treated with dignity, respect, and fairness, regardless of age, ethnicity, or lifestyle.
